target: 淡江大學淡水校本部書卷廣場竹卷雕塑與舊圓階座
scope: Complete single-landmark historical visible exterior approximation, not whole plaza, 2026 condition, exact 1986 original reconstruction, measured survey or print certification. No geometry modified by reviewer.

view_checks.front: White vertical curved sheets, unequal sloping free top edges, partial overlap and visible gaps; concentric old stepped base with wide low rim, five narrow steps and sloped high drum/lip.
view_checks.rear: Reverse curved surface and highest free tip, separated low edges and complete base. Reopened at original image detail: tip about y194/1200 with ample margin. Initial high-detail display impression of clipping was incorrect; no camera change needed.
view_checks.elevation: Relative highest/second/two low sheet hierarchy and upright sheets, no top cap; base profile and lip distinct. Heights are photo approximations, not measured ratios.
view_checks.top: Four individually separated open arcs with central void and four passages; no solid central core or continuous spiral tube. Specific arc centers/spans are editable approximation, not recovered survey geometry.
view_checks.left_oblique: Additional curved inner/outer faces, lower ends and narrow gaps, common base with free surfaces. Some sheets overlap in projection, as in source photos; not additional fifth sheet.

confirmed_features: four distinct curved vertical sheets with unequal sloping free top edges
actual open gaps and no top cap/solid core
five narrow circular stair rings plus broad outer low platform
sloped high central drum with thin projecting top lip
historical complete pedestal only, no new surrounding 2025 paths
limitations: Independent arc centers, radii, spans, thicknesses, precise heights and base proportions are photo-derived estimates, not source-measured values. Top view is a reconstruction parameterization, not a claim of exact site plan.
17 official public main images have no usable original capture dates; directory strings are not capture dates. 1986 is official completion year.
2025 landscaping does not prove altered stair count or buried stairs. SOURCES and generated metadata corrected to avoid that inference.
Masonry joints, weathering, surrounding greenery and whole plaza omitted. Raw source photographs and crops remain private.
High thin free sheet edges and base lip have genuine print warnings. QA reports 11 thin layers/components and 512 downward overhang faces; visual PASS does not certify printing.
review_corrections: Initially suspected rear framing at high-detail multi-image display; original 1200px image personally rechecked and full tip has about194px margin. Concern withdrawn without file changes.
packaging_note: README/SOURCES/QA present and read. Minor uncertain landscape phrasing corrected and verified. Builder owns final isolated rebuild/packaging checks; this review binds only STL and five final PNGs.
